# Subverter
Subverters have a unique game plan compared to the other traitors masks. Instead of focusing on direct sabotage, their kit is focused around converting another player in to the traitor team.
## Tools of the Trade Their cache contains two pistols, two spare 9mm magazines, a subverter chip, and a kockout medipen.
### 9mm Handgun(s) Two run-of-the-mill pistols. You should probably give one of these (and your spare magazine) to whoever you convert, since they won't start with a cache.
### Subverter Chip The subverter chip is an item that, when successfully used on any non-traitor that's unconcious or in critical condition, will convert them in to the traitor organization as a [textlink="Recruit" link="Recruit"], along with healing them. Using the item takes a few seconds and typically makes it fairly obvious to others around you what you're doing, so take caution.
### Knockout Medipen The knockout medipen injects 10 units of chloral hydrate and 5 units of mute toxin in to the target, making them slow, unable to speak, and drowsy enough to fall asleep after about 18 seconds. Once used up, it turns in to a regular-looking empty medipen.
For a Subverter, the knockout medipen is primarily useful for converting whoever you used it on, since it makes the target unconcious.
